name: Panoramax Street Imagery
description: Street-level imagery from the Panoramax open federated network

panoramax.purpose: Street-level imagery. Coverage tiles and image metadata are proxied via BFF. Panoramic imagery is loaded directly from the configured Panoramax instance once an in-app notice is confirmed.
panoramax.dataSent: Coverage tile and metadata requests are proxied. After confirmation, direct browser requests may expose IP address, browser/device request metadata, and the viewed image ID to the Panoramax instance.
panoramax.dataReceived: Nearest image ID, image metadata and navigation links, vector tiles (sequence lines + picture points), and panoramic imagery.
